profile.headline: Electrical Engineer, Software Dev, Technical Trainer, PM, IoT Geek, forever learner!
profile.summary:
I bring over 10 years of experience in technology, electricity, leading multidisciplinary teams, and delivering exceptional customer service. 

My expertise includes python, C+, react, IT implementation, technical training, cybersecurity, hydraulic and pneumatic maintenance management. 

As a PM/PO, I have successfully bridged the gap between senior management, human resources, and operational teams. This blend of technical expertise and leadership skills empowers me to drive innovation, streamline processes, and achieve strategic objectives in dynamic environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Development · Software Design · Industrial Control · Software Quality Assurance · Manufacturing Process Improvement · TypeScript · React.js · GraphQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description:
I’m currently on a professional development sabbatical, focused on designing and prototyping SaaS solutions that address real-world challenges across various industries.

This period for me means... Learn by doing thing like:

- Developing industrial platforms that centralize and visualize telemetry from lab equipment such as Arum CNC machines, Prusa, and Anycubic 3D printers (Already functional)

- Designing software solutions in LegalTech and EdTech, with the goal of transforming these prototypes into full-fledged products

This period is allowing me to deepen my technical expertise, explore emerging technologies as Vibe coding, MCP´s and ML, and apply my experience in IoT, software architecture, and product design to build tools that are both innovative and impactful.

positions.title: Software Process Engineer
positions.description:
At Dandy, I designed, developed, and implemented custom software solutions to interconnect, monitor, and control manufacturing machines and systems. My work focused on enabling real-time telemetry, automation, and seamless integration across the production floor in the lab.

I also created custom-made micro-applications tailored to specific workflows and bottlenecks, as part of a broader process optimization initiative. These tools significantly increased productivity, streamlined operations, and empowered teams with actionable data at every step of production.

In addition, I contributed to the design, optimization, and modification of manufacturing procedures, and served as a key liaison between the global development team and the factory, ensuring that engineering solutions reflected both the technical requirements and the real-world needs of operators and patients.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · React.js · GraphQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · TypeScript · Manufacturing Process Improvement · Process Engineering · Operations Management · Jest · Software Quality Assurance

positions.title: Interim CTO
positions.description: Led cross-functional teams across Europe and Asia to develop advanced protection technologies for industrial and commercial applications. Oversaw and contributed to the design and implementation of software systems driving the digital transformation of local warehouse operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Gestión de relaciones con clientes (CRM) · Sistemas informáticos · Infraestructura de tecnologías de la información · Aplicaciones de Cloud · Planificación de proyectos · Análisis de datos · Análisis de negocio · Project Management · MySQL

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
At SonoArte, I served in multiple key roles, including Software Designer, Project Manager, and SCRUM Master, leading the development of a custom Learning Management System (LMS) tailored for music education. I was responsible for defining product vision, managing agile sprints, and coordinating multidisciplinary teams to deliver scalable and user-friendly digital learning tools for students and educators.

In parallel, I conducted extensive training for music teachers, focusing on pedagogical methodologies and modern teaching techniques. I designed and led professional development programs that helped instructors integrate technology into their curriculum, enhance student engagement, and improve educational outcomes.

This role combined my passions for education, technology, and team leadership, allowing me to drive innovation both in software development and music instruction.
positions.insights: Skills: Docencia · Gestión de relaciones con clientes (CRM) · Metodologías ágiles · Métodos de investigación cualitativa y cuantitativa · Desarrollo metodológico · Software Project Management · Software Design · Agile Application Development · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Computer-Aided Design (CAD) · IT Strategy · Software Industry · Administration · Data Warehousing · Teacher Training

positions.title: Implementation Manager - Panama
positions.description:
As an Implementation Engineer, I designed and deployed custom IT solutions for commercial clients, ensuring full compliance with U.S. cybersecurity regulations and industry best practices.

My responsibilities and accomplishments included:
	- Conducting on-site technical assessments to identify client needs and deliver optimal infrastructure and security recommendations
	- Collaborating with cross-functional teams across the USA, Panama, and Sweden to integrate advanced cybersecurity measures into diverse client environments
	- Representing the company in Panama, providing technical consultations and tailored proposals to prospective clients
	- Staying current with cybersecurity trends through regular training in tools such as ThreatLocker, Huntress, Microsoft 365 services, Unifi, Datto, and Kali Linux

This role strengthened my ability to combine technical execution with client-facing communication, delivering solutions that are both secure and aligned with business objectives.
positions.insights: Skills: IT Strategy · IT Integration · IT Service Management · IT Management · IT Operations · IT Outsourcing · IT Audit · Kali Linux · Cybersecurity · Cybersecurity Tools · Datto Backup

positions.title: Director de Catedra de Piano y Armonia
positions.description:
Instructor responsible for designing and authoring a new teaching methodology aligned with the company’s educational vision, aimed at optimizing the learning process through structured, outcome-based strategies.

This methodology integrated advanced technology, including the use of professional audio editing software and advanced recording workflows, to enhance both the instructional process and student performance. The approach combined pedagogical innovation with technical proficiency, providing students with a hands-on, modern learning experience rooted in real-world music production environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Trabajo en equipo · Planificación de proyectos · Audio Recording · Audio Post Production · Liderazgo de equipos · Gestión de proyectos · Audio Editing · Gestión y motivación de equipos · Pro Tools · Audio Engineering · Audio Mixing · Educational Technology

positions.title: Electrical Maintenance Engineer
positions.description:
Led the modernization of legacy programming and backup protocols for KHS industrial robots with Siemens S5 controllers, enabling compatibility with contemporary operating systems and safeguarding short and medium term investment.

This included:

- Refactoring legacy code and rewriting methods into structured, maintainable programs.
- Designing and delivering a comprehensive training program for technical staff on the updated procedures.
- Conducting extensive testing under various operational scenarios to ensure reliability and safety.
- Developing a custom interface capable of decoding, processing, and re-encoding legacy instruction sets into new data structures, allowing seamless robot programming from modern OS environments instead of outdated and vulnerable platforms like Windows 95.

This initiative significantly extended the lifespan of the automation systems and enhanced operational security and maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Ethical Hacking · Electrical and Instrumentation Engineering (EIE) · Industrial Control · Software Design

positions.title: Industrial Mechanic
positions.description:
Apprentice and Mechanical Workshop Assistant specializing in hydraulic systems and pneumatic diaphragm pumps, with hands-on experience in the repair and maintenance of Link-Belt crane systems.

Responsibilities included the design and fabrication of custom hydraulic solutions, as well as the development of a hydraulic test bench for system diagnostics and quality assurance.

Served key clients across industries such as coal mining, brewing, and food processing, delivering reliable technical support and tailored mechanical solutions for demanding industrial environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Mechanical Engineering · Hydraulic Systems · Pneumatics · Cranes · Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) · Pump Repair · AutoCAD · Computer-Aided Design (CAD)
